_what: Every word of the planning settings form (src/workspace/planning-settings.tsx): what the person sets for the planner. Capacity is the most planned work in a day; hours for one day change only that date.
heading: Planning
capacity: Most planned work in a day (minutes)
band: Warn when a day is this close to full (minutes)
refit: Move planned tasks out of the way when I move a task
timebox_note: Written as events at the time you saw in the preview.
hours_mode: When someone writes to you outside these hours
hours_note: Only whether you are outside them is shared, with the pursuits where you share your calendar.
ai_scheduling_note: Let the planner place your todos on free time. Turn it off and nothing is placed unless you place it.
privacy_note: Private: the event for a planned todo shows only as busy to people who see your calendar. Visible: they see its title.
